packageRules.description: Give each major update its own PR, on a branch named after the dependency (e.g. renovate/github.com-swaggo-files-2.x) rather than a shared renovate/major-<group>.

TypeScript 7 is the Go-ported compiler with a restructured package (no more typescript/lib/tsc export). vue-tsc and typescript-eslint, which the Nuxt sites use, don't support it yet; revisit once they do.
gin-swagger still imports github.com/swaggo/files (v1), so the /v2 module can't replace it yet; revisit once gin-swagger moves to v2.
